plugins.name: avengers
plugins.description: Bruce/Tony/Thor/Steve/Reed design-then-build multi-agent workflow: a deterministic router picks SMALL/MEDIUM/HIGH, Bruce and Tony debate over a versioned canonical state (ACCEPT/PATCH/BLOCK deltas, not a replayed transcript), Thor mediates and hands unresolved calls to the user, Steve plans and self-scrutinizes, Reed implements with bundled Ponytail, Bruce and Tony review the result and drive a bounded fix loop.
